title: Attended
subtitle: 「出席／參加／到場」，從核心近義詞到常用口語與慣用表達。
description: 「出席／參加／到場」，從核心近義詞到常用口語與慣用表達。

words.example: She went to the conference on Friday.
words.exampleZh: 她星期五去了那個會議。

exercises.original: More than 300 people attended the public meeting.
exercises.zh: 超過三百人出席了公眾會議。
exercises.upgrade: More than 300 people went to the public meeting.

options.explanation: public meeting 是活動；went to 自然表示實際去了並出席。
只表示觀看，可能是網上觀看。
表示主辦／主持，不是一般參加者身份。
表示有發表內容，語義比 attended 強。
visit a meeting 不自然；visit 偏到訪地方／人。

exercises.original: She attended a lecture on climate policy last night.
exercises.zh: 她昨晚出席了一場氣候政策講座。
exercises.upgrade: She went to a lecture on climate policy last night.

options.explanation: lecture 是活動，通常不用 visit。
went to a lecture 是最自然的日常改寫。
可能只是觀看錄影，不等於親身出席。

exercises.original: Several teachers attended the training session.
exercises.zh: 幾名老師出席了培訓環節。
exercises.upgrade: Several teachers went to the training session.

options.explanation: 只表示觀看，不等於出席。
training session 不是典型 visit 對象。
保留『去了培訓』的基本意思。

words.example: She was present at the meeting but did not speak.
words.exampleZh: 她有出席會議，但沒有發言。

exercises.original: She attended the meeting but did not speak.
exercises.zh: 她有出席會議，但沒有發言。
exercises.upgrade: She was present at the meeting but did not speak.

options.explanation: did not speak 明確強調只是人在場，非常適合。
主動參與意味過強，和 did not speak 不完全吻合。
表示發表，和 did not speak 矛盾。

exercises.original: All board members attended the hearing.
exercises.zh: 所有董事會成員都有出席聽證會。
exercises.upgrade: All board members were present at the hearing.

options.explanation: 可能過強；原句只保證出席。
正式地表示所有人都在場。
不表示每個人都有發言。
可遠程觀看，不能確保在場。

exercises.original: The mayor attended the ceremony as an invited guest.
exercises.zh: 市長以受邀嘉賓身份出席典禮。
exercises.upgrade: The mayor was present at the ceremony as an invited guest.

options.explanation: ceremony 不是一般 visit 的地點。
只是觀看，缺少正式到場意味。
invited guest + ceremony 很適合正式在場表達。
正式嘉賓通常不是『報名』。

words.example: Several parents joined the information session.
words.exampleZh: 幾名家長參加了資訊講座。

exercises.original: Several parents attended the information session.
exercises.zh: 幾名家長參加了資訊講座。
exercises.upgrade: Several parents joined the information session.

options.explanation: information session 作為群體活動，可自然說 joined。

exercises.original: She attended the online meeting from home.
exercises.zh: 她在家參加了網上會議。
exercises.upgrade: She joined the online meeting from home.

options.explanation: 可能只是看直播，不一定加入會議。
online meeting 最自然的搭配之一就是 join。

exercises.original: More students attended the afternoon session than the morning one.
exercises.zh: 下午環節有更多學生參加。
exercises.upgrade: More students joined the afternoon session than the morning one.

options.explanation: 比較的是實際參加人數，而不是報名人數。
session 作為活動可用 joined。
不表示所有學生都有發表。

words.example: More than fifty students participated in the workshop.
words.exampleZh: 超過五十名學生參與了工作坊。

exercises.original: Fifty students attended the workshop and completed all the activities.
exercises.zh: 五十名學生參加工作坊並完成所有活動。
exercises.upgrade: Fifty students participated in the workshop and completed all the activities.

options.explanation: completed all the activities 顯示主動參與，語義比純出席更準確。
只說人在場，沒有反映完成活動。

exercises.original: She attended the discussion and contributed several ideas.
exercises.zh: 她參與討論並提出了幾個想法。
exercises.upgrade: She participated in the discussion and contributed several ideas.

options.explanation: 她有提出想法，不只是觀看。
contributed several ideas 是主動參與的明確證據。

exercises.original: Teams from twelve schools attended the competition.
exercises.zh: 十二間學校的隊伍參加了比賽。
exercises.upgrade: Teams from twelve schools participated in the competition.

options.explanation: 報名參賽不保證實際出賽。
competition 的參賽者自然用 participated in。
不表示十二隊共同主辦。

words.example: She took part in every activity during the camp.
words.exampleZh: 她參加了營會期間的每一項活動。

exercises.original: Hundreds of residents attended the clean-up activity.
exercises.zh: 數百名居民參加了清潔活動。
exercises.upgrade: Hundreds of residents took part in the clean-up activity.

options.explanation: clean-up activity 要實際動手參與，took part in 很自然。
清潔活動不是單純觀看。

exercises.original: She attended every event in the sports day programme.
exercises.zh: 她參加了運動日的每一項活動。
exercises.upgrade: She took part in every event in the sports day programme.

options.explanation: sports events 若只是觀看則不同；題意是參加活動。
every event in sports day 明確是實際參與。

exercises.original: Students attended the role-play activity in small groups.
exercises.zh: 學生以小組形式參與角色扮演活動。
exercises.upgrade: Students took part in the role-play activity in small groups.

options.explanation: role-play activity 明確需要主動加入。

words.example: About thirty people came to the talk.
words.exampleZh: 大約三十人出席了講座。

exercises.original: About thirty people attended the talk.
exercises.zh: 大約三十人出席了講座。
exercises.upgrade: About thirty people came to the talk.

options.explanation: 口語中很自然地表示三十人來了講座現場。
可在線觀看，不能保證到場。
talk 不是一般 visit 對象。
不表示三十人都是講者。

exercises.original: Many former students attended the reunion.
exercises.zh: 很多舊生都來參加聚會。
exercises.upgrade: Many former students came to the reunion.

options.explanation: reunion 是活動，came to 更自然。
reunion 屬社交聚會，口語中自然。

exercises.original: Only a few residents attended the consultation meeting.
exercises.zh: 只有少數居民來參加諮詢會議。
exercises.upgrade: Only a few residents came to the consultation meeting.

options.explanation: 不能表示實際到場人數。
以到場人數為重點，很自然。

words.example: Nearly everyone showed up at the meeting.
words.exampleZh: 幾乎所有人都有到場參加會議。

exercises.original: Nearly everyone attended the meeting despite the heavy rain.
exercises.zh: 儘管大雨，幾乎所有人都有到場參加會議。
exercises.upgrade: Nearly everyone showed up at the meeting despite the heavy rain.

options.explanation: despite heavy rain 強調實際有沒有出現，非常適合 show up。
報名不受當天天氣是否到場影響。
不表示所有人都有發言。

exercises.original: He attended the event even though he had not confirmed earlier.
exercises.zh: 雖然他之前沒有確認，但最後仍有到場。
exercises.upgrade: He showed up at the event even though he had not confirmed earlier.

options.explanation: 題目明說 earlier 未確認，不是報名重點。
帶有『最後還是出現了』的語氣。

exercises.original: Only half the invited guests attended the reception.
exercises.zh: 只有一半受邀嘉賓到場出席招待會。
exercises.upgrade: Only half the invited guests showed up at the reception.

options.explanation: 嘉賓受邀，不一定需要報名。
invited guests + half 到場，正是 show up 的典型語境。

words.example: Only twelve people turned up at the session.
words.exampleZh: 只有十二人到場參加該環節。

exercises.original: Only twelve people attended the session.
exercises.zh: 只有十二人到場參加該環節。
exercises.upgrade: Only twelve people turned up at the session.

options.explanation: 英式口語中，出席人數很自然用 turned up。
報名人數可能比到場人數多。

exercises.original: Several people attended late because of train delays.
exercises.zh: 幾個人因火車延誤而遲到。
exercises.upgrade: Several people turned up late because of train delays.

options.explanation: turned up late 是高頻搭配。

exercises.original: He attended unexpectedly near the end of the meeting.
exercises.zh: 他在會議接近尾聲時意外到場。
exercises.upgrade: He turned up unexpectedly near the end of the meeting.

options.explanation: unexpectedly 是 turned up 的典型搭配。

words.example: She sat in on the class before deciding whether to enrol.
words.exampleZh: 她先旁聽課堂，再決定是否報讀。

exercises.original: She attended the class as an observer before deciding whether to enrol.
exercises.zh: 她以旁聽者身份出席課堂，再決定是否報讀。
exercises.upgrade: She sat in on the class before deciding whether to enrol.

options.explanation: as an observer 是明確旁聽線索。
題目說她尚未決定是否報讀。

exercises.original: The trainee attended the managers' meeting to observe how decisions were made.
exercises.zh: 實習生列席經理會議，觀察決策過程。
exercises.upgrade: The trainee sat in on the managers' meeting to observe how decisions were made.

options.explanation: 只說觀察，沒有表達正式進入會議旁聽。
to observe + meeting 是典型旁聽語境。

exercises.original: I attended one lecture without being formally registered for the course.
exercises.zh: 我沒有正式報讀課程，但旁聽了一堂講課。
exercises.upgrade: I sat in on one lecture without being formally registered for the course.

options.explanation: 和 without being registered 矛盾。
同樣與未正式報讀矛盾。
未註冊但旁聽 lecture，完全吻合。

words.example: Several senior officials were in attendance at the ceremony.
words.exampleZh: 多名高級官員出席了典禮。

exercises.original: Several senior officials attended the ceremony.
exercises.zh: 多名高級官員出席了典禮。
exercises.upgrade: Several senior officials were in attendance at the ceremony.

options.explanation: senior officials + ceremony 是正式行政語境。
官員受邀出席通常不是報名。
不表示官員都是主辦方。

exercises.original: Members of the royal family attended the official reception.
exercises.zh: 王室成員出席了官方招待會。
exercises.upgrade: Members of the royal family were in attendance at the official reception.

options.explanation: reception 不是一般到訪地點。
official reception 的正式出席語域很吻合。
不表示所有王室成員主辦。

exercises.original: The minutes record which directors attended the meeting.
exercises.zh: 會議紀錄記載哪些董事有出席。
exercises.upgrade: The minutes record which directors were in attendance at the meeting.

options.explanation: 會議紀錄關注實際出席而非報名。
minutes + directors 是典型正式記錄語境。

words.example: Visitors joined in the dancing after the performance.
words.exampleZh: 表演後，訪客也加入跳舞。

exercises.original: Visitors attended the dancing after the performance.
exercises.zh: 表演後，訪客也加入跳舞。
exercises.upgrade: Visitors joined in the dancing after the performance.

options.explanation: dancing 是正在進行、可共同參與的活動。

exercises.original: Everyone attended the singing at the end of the evening.
exercises.zh: 晚會結束時，所有人都一起唱歌。
exercises.upgrade: Everyone joined in the singing at the end of the evening.

options.explanation: singing 是典型 join in 對象。

exercises.original: Parents attended the games with their children.
exercises.zh: 家長和孩子一起參與遊戲。
exercises.upgrade: Parents joined in the games with their children.

options.explanation: games + with their children 表示共同參與。

words.example: Despite the traffic, she made it to the meeting on time.
words.exampleZh: 儘管交通擠塞，她仍成功準時出席會議。

exercises.original: Despite the traffic, she attended the meeting on time.
exercises.zh: 儘管交通擠塞，她仍成功準時出席會議。
exercises.upgrade: Despite the traffic, she made it to the meeting on time.

options.explanation: despite the traffic + on time 明確帶『成功趕到』意味。
不表示克服交通問題到場。

exercises.original: He was ill but still attended the ceremony.
exercises.zh: 他雖然生病，但仍成功出席典禮。
exercises.upgrade: He was ill but still made it to the ceremony.

options.explanation: 可能在家觀看，不能表達克服生病到場。
was ill but still 強烈支持『仍趕到』。

exercises.original: I could not attend the event because my flight was cancelled.
exercises.zh: 因航班取消，我無法趕到活動現場。
exercises.upgrade: I could not make it to the event because my flight was cancelled.

options.explanation: 航班取消不影響是否已報名。
could not make it to 是非常常見的『無法出席』口語表達。

words.example: The director put in an appearance at the reception before leaving early.
words.exampleZh: 導演在招待會露面後便提早離開。

exercises.original: The director attended the reception briefly before leaving.
exercises.zh: 導演短暫出席招待會後便離開。
exercises.upgrade: The director put in an appearance at the reception before leaving.

options.explanation: briefly + before leaving 明確是短暫露面。

exercises.original: She attended the launch for only twenty minutes.
exercises.zh: 她只在發布會露面二十分鐘。
exercises.upgrade: She put in an appearance at the launch for only twenty minutes.

options.explanation: only twenty minutes 是典型短暫露面語氣。
launch 是活動，不是一般 visit 對象。

exercises.original: The actor attended the party long enough for photographers to see him.
exercises.zh: 演員在派對露面了一會兒，讓攝影記者拍到。
exercises.upgrade: The actor put in an appearance at the party long enough for photographers to see him.

options.explanation: long enough for photographers to see him 強調象徵性露面。

words.example: I was there for the opening ceremony but left before lunch.
words.exampleZh: 我有出席開幕典禮，但午飯前便離開。

exercises.original: I attended the opening ceremony but left before lunch.
exercises.zh: 我有出席開幕典禮，但午飯前便離開。
exercises.upgrade: I was there for the opening ceremony but left before lunch.

options.explanation: 口語地表示『有在場參加開幕典禮』，和後半句時間對比自然。

exercises.original: Were you able to attend the final session?
exercises.zh: 你有沒有到場參加最後一節？
exercises.upgrade: Were you there for the final session?

options.explanation: 問的是有沒有實際到場。
口語中自然詢問某人是否在場。

exercises.original: She attended the whole conference from the opening talk to the closing session.
exercises.zh: 她由開幕講座到閉幕環節都在場參加整個會議。
exercises.upgrade: She was there for the whole conference from the opening talk to the closing session.

options.explanation: the whole conference 強調人在場的整段時間。

falseSynonyms.zh: 到訪不等於出席 visit 強調去某個地方或探望某人；attend 強調出席一個活動、課堂、會議或場合。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You can visit a university without attending a class there.

falseSynonyms.zh: 觀看不等於出席 watch 只表示觀看；一個人可以在線觀看活動而沒有親身出席。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Someone may watch a ceremony online without attending it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 觀察不等於一般出席 observe 可以表示觀看或遵守；只有在旁觀語境才和 attend 有少量重疊。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An observer may attend a session, but observing and attending are not identical.

falseSynonyms.zh: 報名不等於出席 register for 表示報名；有人可以報名後缺席。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A person may register for a conference and still fail to attend.

falseSynonyms.zh: 報讀不等於出席 enrol in 表示正式加入課程；學生報讀後仍可能缺課。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Enrolling in a course does not guarantee attending every class.

falseSynonyms.zh: 參與不一定等於純粹出席 participate in 是重要近義詞，但語義更強，表示主動參與；若只是坐在場內聽講，就不能機械替換。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A person can attend a workshop without actively participating in every activity.

falseSynonyms.zh: 主持／主辦不等於出席 host 表示負責主辦或接待；主持人當然可能在場，但角色與 attendee 不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The organisation hosted the meeting; the delegates attended it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 發表不等於出席 present at 表示在活動中作報告或發表；出席者未必有發言。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A researcher may attend a conference without presenting at it.
